data: An immutable composition of named, reusable steps over a fresh typed context.
public sealed class Scenario<TContext> where TContext : notnull
The scenario's stable identity in results and reports. It defaults to the name.
public string Id { get; }
The scenario's name, as reports show it.
public string Name { get; }
An optional longer description of the scenario.
public string? Description { get; }
The business context this scenario belongs to, if any.
public BusinessContext? Business { get; }
Where this scenario's work is tracked, in addition to references on its business context.
public ImmutableArray<ExternalReference> References { get; }
Links this scenario to where its work is tracked, such as a ticket.
public Scenario<TContext> Reference(string provider, string key, Uri? url = null)
